reason: Under fixed cell, partner, both concentrations and iteration, no comparison has >=3 distinct measurement files per arm. Some groups have >=3 wells but only <=2 files; wells cannot be treated as independent biological replicates. Equivalence CI/TOST was therefore not run. Descriptive nontrivial counts are not equivalence results.
limits: No time/exposure column is provided; iteration and file matching cannot prove all exposure conditions identical.
0.1 is an exploratory margin, not externally validated assay tolerance.
Design comparisons share arms and are not independent hypotheses.
This does not refute conditional substitution as a biological possibility.
